title: naive_infinite_scroll benchmark occasionally times out with JS

milestone.title: alpha-29
milestone.description: Current milestone. Work on all issues to complete by Monday June 29 @ 8am PT; sync internal/external by July 1 EOD (before the US holiday weekend). Yegor is owner for the sync.

body:
